articles.summary: Following the reveal of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake earlier this year, Nintendo shared an extended look at the game during the company's latest Direct.
body: The new looks for young Link and some of the other character inspired a round of memes and jokes.

articles.title: Shift Up CTO Clarifies Stellar Blade Developer's Stance on AI After Blood Rain Music Video Controversy
articles.summary: Shift Up’s chief technology officer, DongKi Lee, has clarified the developer’s stance on AI after a music video for Stellar Blade: Blood Rain sparked backlash last month.
body: The music video, set to an upbeat pop song titled "Wanna be in Love," featured AI-generated images and footage that focused on Blood Rain’s main character, Evie, as she sang, danced, and made her way through the game’s futuristic world.

The public response was far from positive; players instantly lashed out at Shift Up for eschewing human employees in favor of having AI make the video, criticisms that the developer’s CEO, Kim Hyung Tae, argued against.

"EVIE, the character at the heart of this video, was created from head to toe by our talented artists and modelers through more than a year of dedicated work. The AI is not creating her from scratch. It is rendering and presenting the character based on the data, designs, and craftsmanship our team created. We would truly appreciate it if you could view the work with that understanding in mind," he wrote.

Shift Up’s CTO has now shed a bit more light on the situation now that tensions have cooled. In a September 2 interview with TheGamer, Lee explained that the company merely wanted to show off more of Evie’s world with its AI music video, and clarified that such content is "experimental" and not a reflection of the official game.

articles.title: Xbox’s Disc-To-Digital Program Has A Big Problem: Several Major Publishers Aren’t Participating
articles.summary: Xbox's disc-to-digital program looks like it could be a vital step forward for players who want to hold on to their physical games in an increasingly digital world, but it does have limits.
body: So far, it looks like games from Sega, Square Enix, Ubisoft, and Bandai Namco are largely incompatible with the disc-to-digital service. As verified by Kotaku, popping in a disc for a game from one of those publishers could result in a "not participating in digital licensing" message. A fan effort to catalogue all the games that do work with it also shows which titles from those publishers are incompatible with disc-to-digital, so if you were holding on to a physical edition of Far Cry 4, Final Fantasy 15, or Dark Souls 3, you're out of luck.

This is something that Square Enix has been called to task over, as several of its big HD-2D RPGs have no upgrade path to Switch 2. For example, if you purchased Octopath Traveler for the Switch, there's no complimentary or premium upgrade pack to give it sharper graphics and new features on a Switch 2 console. Instead, you'll have to buy the game again when its Switch 2 version launches, and you don't even get an option to transfer your save game over.
points: Xbox's disc-to-digital program looks like it could be a vital step forward for players who want to hold on to their physical games in an increasingly digital world, but it does have limits.

articles.title: 'It Definitely Was a Shock': The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Artwork Splits Fans Following Trailer Reveal
articles.summary: What do you think of the new art style for Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake? It's the big question that fans have been discussing ever since today's Zelda Direct — and now they're poring over new artwork, too.
body: Looking over social media commentary alongside the Direct itself, there was a fair amount of surprise at how different this version of Nintendo's N64 classic actually looked. Of course, the visuals in this ground-up Ocarina remake have been given a vast upgrade. But the visual style employed here by Nintendo looks unlike any other Zelda game seen to date.

The intent here, I think, is to create something that bridges the gap between the Switch 2's technical capability while retaining the slightly exaggerated and angular aesthetic of the N64 original. There's also a conscious decision not to turn this version of Ocarina into something it's not — a cel-shaded game, something stylized in the same fashion as Breath of the Wild, or even the grittier 3D tones of Twilight Princess.

Of course, not everyone is a fan. "They Cocomelon'd all of them 😞," wrote one fan, examining the character artwork that Nintendo has now released via Ocarina of Time's Japanese website (check it out in the slideshow of images above). "Kid Link looks like a goldfish," wrote another.
points: What do you think of the new art style for Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake?
It's the big question that fans have been discussing ever since today's Zelda Direct — and now they're poring over new artwork, too.

The mobile 5090 also has 24GB of VRAM. Although that's less than the 32GB of the desktop 5090, that's the same amount of VRAM found in the desktop 4090 and more than any other NVIDIA card. articles.title: GameStop Sets A New Financial Record, And It’s No Thanks To Games
articles.summary: Retailer GameStop has released its latest earnings report, and it was a record-breaker for the company. The Texas-based retailer's biggest number for its fiscal Q2 quarter that ended August 1 was $160.2 million.
body: Net income was up, too, reaching $298.7 million, compared to $168.6 million last year.

GameStop benefitted from continued growth in its biggest sales category--collectibles--which saw net sales jump a whopping 57% year-over-year to $356.3 million. For this latest period, collectibles made up 45.1% of GameStop's net sales.

GameStop was once primarily known as a video game retailer, and while it still sells games, consoles, and accessories, the company's biggest revenue-driver today is collectibles. Anyone who has walked into a GameStop store recently can attest to how much shelf space is dedicated to collectibles.

GameStop's next-largest revenue-driver was its "video game" category, which reached $263.2 million for the period, down sharply from $494.6 million during the same period last year that benefitted from the Switch 2 launch. Finally, GameStop's pre-owned and refurbished business made up $170.7 million during the period, down from $250 million last year.

articles.title: Marvel's Ex-Blade Director Finally Made the Mahershala Ali Movie of His Dreams
articles.summary: This did not impede Tariq from living the dream. Out of the ashes of Blade comes Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, a riveting, often spectral drama about a Muslim contract killer fighting to protect his children and provide for his newborn baby.
body: In 2021, director Bassam Tariq got the call of a lifetime: Marvel Studios wanted him to direct Blade. The indie filmmaker behind Riz Ahmed’s hip-hop drama Mogul Mowgli jumped at the chance to resurrect the vampire hunter with Oscar-winner Mahershala Ali ( Moonlight ) as the daywalker. But the dream never happened; by 2022, Tariq had departed the film, which then languished in development only to be dropped from Marvel’s future slate entirely.

Ahead of Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother ’s world premiere at the 2026 Toronto Film Festival and its Sept. 25 release date, I had a chance to speak to Tariq about crafting such a personal film that doubles as an adrenaline rush. You bet your ass Shenmue came up in conversation with a filmmaker whose inspirations range from video games to Lynne Ramsay and his own life as a parent.

Polygon: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother is a movie where the director and lead actor feel in perfect sync, then drop a hammer on the audience. How would you describe your connection with Mahershala Ali going into this?

articles.title: Official GTA 6 Release Time Could Mean Long Waits for Some Players
articles.summary: The PlayStation Store may offer official new details on the release timings for Grand Theft Auto 6 across multiple regions, revealing that Rockstar Games may have a staggered launch for its upcoming sequel.
body: Polygon has reached out to Rockstar for confirmation on the matter, but as of now, it seems that Grand Theft Auto 6 won't roll out simultaneously in all territories. The game will reportedly become available at 12 a.m. local time in each region, resulting in players across the world accessing it at different times, based on PlayStation Store data.

A staggered release may look bad at first glance, but it means that some fans can cheat the system and technically play it early. Xbox players can easily change their console's region to New Zealand and access the game as soon as 12 a.m. NZDT hits. As for the PlayStation release, accounts are region-locked, making this process much more complicated. It's unclear at this stage if Rockstar can convince Sony to change how it handles region-based rollouts.

To play GTA 6 early on PlayStation, users will have to make a new PlayStation account and set its region to New Zealand. On top of this, they'd have to play the game on this account rather than their main account because Grand Theft Auto 6 is region-locked on PlayStation.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X on Nov. 19.

articles.title: Nintendo Doesn't Care About GTA 6
articles.summary: Nintendo has gone ahead and broken a commandment that the mainstream video game industry seemed to have imposed on itself for 2026: thou shalt not release a game in the same month as Grand Theft Auto 6.
body: As it stands, Nintendo is the only major publisher willing to take a chance on a November release date (unless you count Sega/Atlus' release of the Switch 2 version of Metaphor: ReFantazio on Nov. 12). Most of the competition has crammed itself into September and October; a few games will see the light of day in early December, including strategy sequel Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 and Nintendo's own re-release of Xenoblade Chronicles 3.

GTA 6 's blast radius has been agreed by some kind of industry consensus for a while, and Nintendo is showing some daring by stepping into it. There's no question that it's a risk. Go too soon after GTA 6, and a colossal portion of the gaming audience will be otherwise occupied; too soon before, and gamers will have earmarked their time and disposable income already.

Nintendo, however, doesn't seem to care. The company loves to give the impression that it is blithely unconcerned with what the rest of the gaming world is up to, but I'm sure that's not the case. So what gives it the confidence to sidle so close to what's expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time — confidence that nobody else in the game industry seems to have?

articles.title: Original Star Wars Officially Returns in IMAX 70mm for the First Time
articles.summary: Han will shoot first in 70 mm IMAX when the original Star Wars returns to movie theaters next year. On Tuesday, Lucasfilm and IMAX confirmed that the 50th anniversary rerelease of Star Wars will be on the biggest screens possible next February, giving fans a strong reason to return to movie…
body: In an official announcement on StarWars.com, Lucasfilm says Star Wars "will be shown across a select number of IMAX 70 mm film locations as well as playing in select theaters for a limited time."

That's not the only Star Wars release getting the deluxe IMAX treatment next year. Lucasfilm and IMAX reconfirmed that next year's stand-alone adventure Star Wars: Starfighter is also coming to the large-screen format. On May 28, 2027, Lucasfilm will release Star Wars: Starfighter, which was filmed for IMAX, shot with IMAX-certified film cameras, and converted to IMAX 70 mm film prints for release in a select number of IMAX film locations, according to an official announcement.

Star Wars: Starfighter is directed by Shawn Levy ( Deadpool & Wolverine, Stranger Things ) and stars Ryan Gosling ( Blade Runner 2049, Barbie ) as Kade Auberon, "a cynical rogue" who is "hurled into a dangerous adventure across the galaxy that puts him on a crash course with destiny." Starfighter also stars Matt Smith, Mia Goth, Aaron Pierre, Jamael Westman, Daniel Ings, Flynn Gray, and Amy Adams. The movie was written by Jonathan Tropper ( Warrior, The Adam Project ).

articles.title: Battlefield 6 Redsec is borrowing yet another mode from Call of Duty: Warzone - Resurgence
articles.summary: It's been argued that Battlefield 6 's Redsec battle royale off-shoot is a response to Call of Duty's popular Warzone mode, and today's news is another indication of that.
body: Battlefield Studios has unveiled Rapid Royale, Redsec's version of Warzone's Resurgence. If you're unfamiliar, Resurgence takes place on dedicated maps that are far smaller than the main mode's large playground, and offers many ways to respawn after death. The pace is significantly faster with more frequent firefights as a result, and these are the principles guiding the Redsec version, too.

Rapid Royale features a reduced player count and is likewise only available on maps smaller than the main mode's. The circles move faster, too, further pushing players closer and closer together. Expect matches that finish quickly, notably a lot shorter than the main mode.

Rapid Royale is one of several new additions coming to Battlefield 6 and Redsec with Season 5, which does not yet have a release date. While we wait for that, Season 4's final stage - named Tidal Strike - kicks off 15th September and introduces the first iteration of proximity chat.

As the name suggests, the feature allows players to communicate with others around them who are not part of their squad. It's initially available only in battle royale, with the plan to expand it to Battlefield 6 multiplayer down the road.

articles.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake gameplay finally revealed during 40th anniversary Nintendo Direct, and it looks… interesting
articles.summary: Gameplay has been released for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake at long last during today's Zelda 40th anniversary Nintendo Direct. It'll be releasing on the Nintendo Switch 2 on the 5th November.
body: The gameplay, narrated by producer Eiji Aonuma, shows what looks to be a largely faithful recreation of the original 3rd person adventure classic, albeit with some modern advancements. For one, Link can jump manually now, and the whole game has been brought to life in a new engine.

A lot of classic sounds and animations also appear to have been either brought over untouched, or recreated faithfully. The famous chest opening animation, for example, looks very much the same as it did all those years ago. Just with that newer aesthetic applied to it.

Some new features for the game worth highlighting: Link can now jump, swim and dive underwater, he can swap between items with single button, characters are fully voiced in cutscenes, Hyrule Castle Town has some new areas previously closed off, you can dash to move faster, time of day now progresses in real-time everywhere. Nintendo, interestingly, says the new game still has loading screens to maintin the feeling of the original.

A particularly cool feature was also shown in regards to playing Link's iconic ocarina. Players can turn on their microphone and hum, whistle, or sing the various tunes required for gameplay changes to occur.
points: Gameplay has been released for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake at long last during today's Zelda 40th anniversary Nintendo Direct.
It'll be releasing on the Nintendo Switch 2 on the 5th November.

videos.summary: Get a closer look at gameplay from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake in this latest video for the upcoming remake of the 1998 adventure game. This new gameplay video, led by series producer Eiji Aonuma, showcases Kokiri Village, Hyrule Field, and Hyrule Castle Town.
points: Get a closer look at gameplay from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake in this latest video for the upcoming remake of the 1998 adventure game.
This new gameplay video, led by series producer Eiji Aonuma, showcases Kokiri Village, Hyrule Field, and Hyrule Castle Town.
New features also show that time no longer stops in towns, and day and night cycles will continue.
You can also hum songs Link has learned that will play on the Ocarina, and the game will also react to instruments.
